pages.title: A Compooper Full of Lava
pages.text: Right-click a lava toilet while holding an empty compooper to collect lava.$(br2)Use a bucket on the lava compooper to get a lava bucket.

pages.title: Using Lava
pages.text: A lava compooper stores lava and can process items.$(br2)Pour lava next to water to obtain cobblestone.
